scenarios.name: S1 command completed, answer lost
passed: the kernel finished the move and the button is held
the move with a lost answer ends as the console's timeout
the tap queued behind it is reported as not sent
the queued tap never reached the kernel
the release is confirmed and the board's button is up
after the failure only /input/release went out: no replay, no /mouse/up, no acquire, renewal or Resume
the phone stays paused: the next tap is refused before it leaves

cleanup detail: the kernel closed this lease and released the button

scenarios.name: S2 kernel command deadline
passed: the hung move ends as a timeout or a kernel failure
the release is confirmed and the board's button is up
after the failure only /input/release and /input/status went out: no replay, no /mouse/up, no acquire, renewal or Resume

cleanup detail: the kernel had already closed this lease and released the button

scenarios.name: S3 kernel command failure
passed: the failed move ends as a kernel failure
the refused release is confirmed from the kernel's status
after the failure only /input/release and /input/status went out: no replay, no /mouse/up, no acquire, renewal or Resume

cleanup detail: the kernel had already closed this lease and released the button

scenarios.name: S4 release refused, explicit Resume retries it
passed: a refused release is reported as attempted, not confirmed
the button is still down on the kernel
after the failure only /input/release went out: no replay, no /mouse/up, no acquire, renewal or Resume
the operator's Resume releases the kept lease and the button comes up
input works again after Resume

measured.cleanup detail: the release request failed (Response status code does not indicate success: 503 (Service Unavailable).)

scenarios.name: S5 stale release after ownership changed
passed: the newer controller's button is still held and the board saw nothing more
the newer controller's lease still works
the stale release is reported as confirmed by the kernel's earlier close

measured.cleanup detail: the kernel had already closed this lease and released the button

scenarios.name: S6 release lost, lease-expiry fallback
passed: a release with no answer is reported as attempted, not confirmed
the kernel's lease expiry lifts the button within 30 s of the last renewal
after the failure only /input/release went out: no replay, no /mouse/up, no acquire, renewal or Resume

measured.cleanup detail: no answer to the release request (The request was canceled due to the configured HttpClient.Timeout of 8 seconds elapsing.)

scenarios.name: S7 mock kernel refuses a port another listener holds
passed: an http.sys listener for /api/ on the port: startup refused (exit 3)
a plain socket on the port: startup refused (exit 3)

scenarios.name: S8 mock kernel starts, self-checks and serves only the simulated board
passed: the board list is exactly the simulated board
kernel status answers through the front
stops cleanly when cancelled (exit 0)
the port is free again afterwards

scenarios.name: S9 Home: emitted HID reports under a simplified text-field model (not iOS behaviour)
passed: vendor (release default): the emitted Home includes a Tab, which a focused field would type
command-h: the emitted Home has no typed key, only GUI+H
command-wake: the emitted Home has no typed key, only GUI+H
